Decide binary PASS or FAIL strictly on the criterion. No partial credit. Accept different wording that communicates the same required meaning. Do not require a message to repeat its recipient's name. Fail when the completed action omits, contradicts, or leaves unclear a required meaning. Output ONLY valid JSON in this shape:

{"passed": true, "reason": "a concise explanation naming the exact supporting text or the exact missing requirement"}
